verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩ : ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਮੰਦੇ ਹਾਲ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 13 : poore satiguroo binaa(n) ma(n)dhe haal

en.bdb: Without true Guru hard times are there

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਛਡਿ ਕੈ ਭਵਜਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਭੰਭਲਭੂਸੇ।
verses.translit_en: sukh saagar guroo chhadd kai bhavajal a(n)dhar bha(n)bhalabhoose|

en.bdb: Leaving the Guru, the Pleasure Ocean, one tosses up and down in the world-ocean of delusions and deceptions.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਹਰੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਛਾੜੀਅਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਗਨੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲੂਸੇ।
verses.translit_en: laharee naal pachhaaReean haumai aganee a(n)dhar loose|

en.bdb: The stroke of the waves of the world-ocean tosses and the fire of ego continuously burns the inner self.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਨਿ ਜਮਦੂਤਾਂ ਦੇ ਧਕੇ ਧੂਸੇ।
verses.translit_en: jam dhar badhe maareean jamadhootaa(n) dhe dhake dhoose|

en.bdb: Tied and beaten at the door of death, one receives the kicks of the messengers of death.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੋਇਲਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਨ ਨਾਉ ਧਰਾਇਨਿ ਈਸੇ ਮੂਸੇ।
verses.translit_en: goil vaasaa chaar dhin naau dharain ieese moose|

en.bdb: May be some one has named himself after Christ or Moses, but in this world all are to stay for a few days.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਅਖਾਇਦਾ ਆਪੋ ਧਾਪੀ ਹੈਰਤ ਹੂਸੇ।
verses.translit_en: ghaT na koi akhaidhaa aapo dhaapee hairat hoose|

en.bdb: Here none deems himself lesser one and all are engrossed in the rat race for selfish ends to find themselves shocked ultimately.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਇਰ ਦੇ ਮਰਜੀਵੜੇ ਕਰਨਿ ਮਜੂਰੀ ਖੇਚਲ ਖੂਸੇ।
verses.translit_en: sair dhe marajeevaRe karan majooree khechal khoose|

en.bdb: Those who are divers of the pleasure-ocean existing in the form of Guru, only they remain happy in the labour (of spiritual discipline).
Without the true Guru, all are always at loggerheads.
